findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: compliance_queue_optimize, wallet_watchlist_add, wallet_watchlist_alerts, wallet_watchlist_events · Private data: wallet_screen, compliance_edd_report, compliance_exposure_report, screening_verify, saved_results, saved_results_delete, wallet_watchlist, wallet_watchlist_add, wallet_watchlist_remove, wallet_watchlist_alerts, saved_results_save, sanctions_party_screen, wallet_payee_check, wallet_watchlist_events, wallet_watchlist_test_alert, account_api_keys, account_api_key_create, account_api_key_revoke, saved_results_export · Public sink: wallet_watchlist_add, wallet_watchlist_alerts, wallet_payee_check, wallet_watchlist_events, wallet_watchlist_test_alert, account_api_key_create, account_api_key_revoke · Destructive: saved_results_delete, wallet_watchlist_remove, saved_results_save.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: compliance_queue_optimize, wallet_watchlist_add, wallet_watchlist_alerts, wallet_watchlist_events · Private data: wallet_screen, compliance_edd_report, compliance_exposure_report, screening_verify, saved_results, saved_results_delete, wallet_watchlist, wallet_watchlist_add, wallet_watchlist_remove, wallet_watchlist_alerts, saved_results_save, sanctions_party_screen, wallet_payee_check, wallet_watchlist_events, wallet_watchlist_test_alert, account_api_keys, account_api_key_create, account_api_key_revoke, saved_results_export · Public sink: wallet_watchlist_add, wallet_watchlist_alerts, wallet_payee_check, wallet_watchlist_events, wallet_watchlist_test_alert, account_api_key_create, account_api_key_revoke · Destructive: saved_results_delete, wallet_watchlist_remove, saved_results_save

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "server_capabilities" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Free first-call capability and connection check for AurelianFlo; use it before paid tools to inspect OFAC screening workflows, access modes, and x402 payment requirements." → after: "Free first-call capability and connection check for AurelianFlo; use it first to see the tools, your daily limits (or prices without an account), free test inputs, sample responses, and how to sign in."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
